name: Open Hiring Harness
known_limitations: v0.2 serves the whole harness from one public file, so sections marked permissioned or private are readable by anyone. A protected access model is planned for v0.3.
description: An open, privacy-first specification for publishing hireable professional identity — for humans and AI agents.

entity_types.description: A human professional publishing their hireable identity
An AI agent acting on behalf of a human, declared within the human's harness
An AI agent publishing its own harness as an independent hireable entity

docs.title: MCP Interface
docs.description: How AI agents interact with a harness via Model Context Protocol

docs.title: Consent Log
docs.description: How consent receipts are stored and managed

docs.title: v0.3 proposal: protected access, provenance and profile kinds
docs.description: Draft. Serves non-public sections from a protected endpoint via OAuth (UMA 2.0), adds provenance to every claim, profile kinds, organisation harnesses and a delegate role

docs.title: Two-way trust between agents
docs.description: Early draft. Agents on both sides of hiring reveal more in stages, each unlocked by what the other side has shown

docs.title: Agent Entities
docs.description: Proposal for AI agents as hireable entities (delegated and autonomous)

agent_instructions.to_read_public: Access the harness JSON directly — public fields require no consent
agent_instructions.to_request_access: Provide requester identity, purpose, and requested scopes via the consent flow
agent_instructions.to_publish: Host a valid harness at your operator's domain under /.well-known/hiring-harness.json
